_meanings:
‘Inferior knowledge’, a class of writings subordinate to
 the Vedas. There are four such {%Upavedas%},

 one being attached to each of the four Vedas:-- thus {#Ayurveda#} or Medicine
 to {#fgveda#}; (according to some authorities such as Suśruta it is a
 part of the Atharvaveda); {#Danurveda#} or military science to {#yajurveda#};
 {#gAnDarvaveda#} or Music to {#sAmaveda#}, and {#sTApatya-SAstra-veda#}
 or Architecture to {#aTarvaveda#}.
